parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description: The list of device names to be distributed. The list can contain up to 1000 device names.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs.

parameters.name: SourceInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the source instance to which the device belongs.

- Public instance IDs by region:

    - China (Shanghai): iotx-oxssharez200.
    - Japan (Tokyo): iotx-oxssharez300.
    - Singapore (Singapore): iotx-oxssharez400.
    - US (Silicon Valley): iotx-oxssharez500.
    - US (Virginia): iotx-oxssharez600.
    - Germany (Frankfurt): iotx-oxssharez700.

- Enterprise instance ID:
    
    1. Log on to the IoT Platform console and select a region from the drop-down menu in the upper-left corner of the top navigation bar.
    
    2. On the **Instance Overview** page, click the instance name. On the **Instance Details** page, view the **Instance ID** in the **Instance Basic Information** section.

parameters.name: Strategy
parameters.description:
The distribution strategy. Default value: 0.

- **0**: Specifies a region to distribute the device to a single instance in the specified region.
- **1**: Nearest access. Configure instance IDs in multiple regions. The device dynamically connects to the nearest region based on its IP location.

parameters.name: TargetAliyunId
parameters.description:
The Alibaba Cloud account to which the device belongs. To view the account, log on to the IoT Platform console, click the profile picture, and go to the **Security Settings** page.

You must specify at least one of the **TargetUid** and **TargetAliyunId** parameters.

parameters.name: TargetInstanceConfig
parameters.description: The list of target instance configurations.

sub_parameters.name: TargetInstanceId
sub_parameters.description:
The target instance configuration for device distribution. For more information about instance IDs, see the description of the **SourceInstanceId** parameter.

- If the **Strategy** parameter is set to **1**, you can specify multiple instance IDs.
- If the **Strategy** parameter is set to **0**, specify only one instance ID.

parameters.name: TargetUid
parameters.description:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID to which the device belongs. To view the account ID, log on to the IoT Platform console, click the profile picture, and go to the **Security Settings** page.

You must specify at least one of the **TargetUid** and **TargetAliyunId** parameters.
